chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Chicago theater and Spikes's trips to New York
summary: In Chicago about 1910-11 the show played a big theater; Spikes returned home in 1912 and did not reach New York until later.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I don't remember that theater now but it was right across the street from the big swimmer--what was her name? Mmmmmm, oh, I can't think of her name now. I had it just then but...uh... She had a big swimming act--a girl, and we was across from her in a big theater there. I can't think of it. It's been too far...
That was about what year then? How far have we gotten now? To what year?
That was about...uh...oh, about '10...'11. Yeah. I came home in '12, I think, and never went back any more.
You never did get to New York then?
Oh, I went to New York several times but I didn't get to New York with the Bill Bailey, and my brother and I never got there together, but I've been there several times for other things, you know.
When was the first time you got to New York?
